evidence.quote:
To address this gap, we propose an Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Agent (
PsychAgent
) for AI psychological counseling. Drawing inspiration from how human counselors improve through practice, our framework combines a Memory-Augmented Planning Engine for longitudinal continuity, a Skill Evolution Engine for extracting practice-grounded therapeutic skills from historical counseling trajectories, and a Reinforced Internalization Engine for integrating these evolved skills into model parameters via rejection fine-tuning. Experimental results show that PsychAgent achieves higher scores than strong general LLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4

and domain-specific baselines, supporting the usefulness of learning from accumulated counseling experience.

Our main contributions are summarized as follows:

•

We propose
PsychAgent
, which, to our knowledge, is among the first frameworks to formulate AI psychological counseling as an experience-driven lifelong learning problem, loosely inspired by the professional development of human counselors.

•

We design a Memory-Augmented Planning Engine for longitudinal continuity, and a Skill Evolution mechanism combined with Reinforced Internalization to enable the autonomous discovery and assimilation of therapeutic skills. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating superior generalization and consistency in providing professional counseling services compared to existing methods.

Under this criterion, the answer is clearly positive. Across 715 dialogue records, the extraction pipeline produces 9,701 atomic skills, among which 5,923 qualify as practice-grounded skill units (

These results show that the dominant outcome of extraction is not restatement, but the distillation of practically enriched skill units relative to the closest existing micro-skills.

The practical increments are also highly consistent across orientations. The most frequent additions are clearer operational sequencing, minimum viable actions, quantitative thresholds, structured templates, monitoring or recording loops, and pause or rollback rules. In other words, the model does not mainly invent completely new therapy techniques; instead, it absorbs interactional experience from counseling trajectories and re-expresses it as more executable local skill units. At the same time, our stricter global audit finds no sufficiently supported candidates for
entirely novel therapy techniques
relative to the initial library. Even the strongest cases are better understood as stable repackagings of existing techniques with added thresholds, templates, monitoring rules, or minimum-action designs.

evidence.quote:
Taken together, these cases clarify what it means for skill extraction to produce new practice-grounded skill units. The resulting skills are not merely longer descriptions of existing entries; instead, they encode interaction-derived thresholds, monitoring rules, minimum viable actions, sequencing constraints, and reusable templates that are not fully specified by the closest existing micro-skills. This is why the strongest supported conclusion is not that the model invents entirely new therapy techniques, but that it reliably distills practically enriched skill units from counseling trajectories.

C.2
Operational New Functional Skills

To better understand why internalization improves counseling performance, we compare post-internalization behavior against both the initialized skill library and the SFT baseline. Two observations are central. First, internalization does not simply increase the number of multi-skill turns. Instead, it reorganizes existing micro-skills into more stable and functionally coherent turn-level packages. Second, some of these internalized packages are reused across therapies, suggesting that the model acquires transferable counseling principles rather than only therapy-specific templates. Together, these patterns indicate that internalization pushes the model toward a more general and versatile counselor.

The clearest evidence for internalization is not a mechanical increase in multi-skill turns, but the emergence of recurrent higher-order packages with clearer local intervention functions. In other words, the model does not merely place multiple skill labels in the same turn; rather, it increasingly organizes several existing micro-skills into compact intervention units that behave like
new functional skills
at the operational level.

Importantly, these packages should not be interpreted as newly invented canonical techniques. A more conservative interpretation is that internalization compresses multiple known micro-skills into recurrent, stable, and functionally closed turn-level units. This is why the strongest evidence for compositional generalization comes from the quality and stability of these packages, rather than from raw bundle counts alone.
evidence.support_explanation: SFT6701 session/154966 turns vs internalization729/20869；functional包装≠新canonical技巧。

evidence.quote:
Several reusable functional families illustrate the same pattern.
Goal-to-Practice Bridge
appears across multiple therapies as a shared logic for translating insight, discussion, or formulation into concrete between-session action.
Progress Consolidation Package
recurs as a stable way of summarizing gains, affirming client competence, and orienting the next phase of work.
Affect Attunement Before Deeper Work
shows another transferable structure, in which the counselor first stabilizes or names the client’s emotional experience before moving into more challenging exploratory work. In each case, what travels across therapies is not merely a skill label, but an intervention principle.

This distinction is important. The evidence does not support the stronger claim that internalization turns the model into a fully therapy-agnostic counselor, nor that it frequently produces large numbers of exact cross-therapy bundles. What it does support is a more careful conclusion: internalization enables some higher-order functional skills to be reused in multiple therapeutic contexts, suggesting that the model learns counseling principles that are portable beyond a single therapy-specific template.

Taken together, these findings indicate that internalization improves both the compositional organization and the portability of counseling skills. The model becomes better at turning existing micro-skills into reusable functional units, and some of these units begin to generalize across therapies. In this sense, internalization moves the model toward a more general and versatile counselor.
evidence.support_explanation: 跨疗法功能family复用仅部分，不支持fully therapy-agnostic。

evidence.support_explanation: 训练奖励与评测协议同属 PsychEval 的 LLM 评审指标族（our_inference：奖励与评测高度耦合）。

evidence.quote: We adopt the evaluation protocol of PsychEval
evidence.support_explanation: 评测采用 PsychEval 协议，与奖励设计同源。

evidence.quote: This ensures that the agent's lifelong learning path is constructed solely from its most successful interactions
evidence.support_explanation: 每个会话步骤仅保留奖励最高的候选 S*，其余丢弃；技能抽取与 RFT 都基于该轨迹（共享 rollout）。

evidence.quote: The model is fine-tuned to maximize the likelihood of the selected "golden" trajectory
evidence.support_explanation: 权重更新：对选定轨迹做 RFT。

evidence.quote: For each therapeutic school, we sample 140 client profiles, using 120 for training and 20 for evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 每个学派 120 训练/20 评测客户画像；共 5 学派约 100 个评测画像。

evidence.quote: we first perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the released multi-session counseling corpus, and then reuse its pool of 2,000+ client profiles for both rollout training and evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: SFT 语料与评测所用画像池同源；未说明 SFT 语料是否含评测画像（our_inference：重叠未检验）。

evidence.quote: Training is conducted on two servers, each equipped with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs.
evidence.support_explanation: 训练硬件已报告；总 GPU 小时/rollout 成本未报告；N=8 并行 rollout。
通用 LLM 基线（咨询师侧共享/特定、客户侧共享/特定）。
领域基线；TheraMind 为最近邻纵向咨询 agent。
PsychAgent(8B†) 与 (32B)：4 个聚合维度 7.32/7.91/5.92/8.24；8B 版与 32B 几乎相同。

evidence.quote: improves counselor-level shared/specific scores by +1.44/+0.17 and client-level shared/specific scores by +0.51/+0.43
evidence.support_explanation: 相对最强通用基线 Qwen3-Max 的差距：咨询师特定维度仅 +0.17。

evidence.quote: achieves the best or second-best result on every dimension, which suggests that the improvements are associated with the proposed lifelong learning framework in addition to model scale.
evidence.support_explanation: 8B 版也强，作者据此说明 '非规模所致'；但未排除 '在同分布 PsychEval 上做了 SFT' 这一解释。
消融：去任一引擎的降幅约 0.06-0.52，远小于与基线的 1.07-1.44 的差距；没有 '仅 SFT' 的底座行。

evidence.quote: At the same time, our stricter global audit finds no sufficiently supported candidates for entirely novel therapy techniques relative to the initial library.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自述演化出的技能是对初始库的实用性细化，而非全新技术。

evidence.quote: the extraction pipeline produces 9,701 atomic skills, among which 5,923 qualify as practice-grounded skill units
evidence.support_explanation: 技能统计（库质量统计），无下游增益对照；'practice-grounded' 的判定方法未在材料中说明。

evidence.quote: the comparison baseline is the v3 library within the same therapeutic orientation and stage, where micro-skills are already fine-grained
evidence.support_explanation: 存在一个专家初始技能库 v3；评测消融没有 '仅初始库 vs 演化库' 的对比。
给通用 LLM 加通用记忆无益；但对照 PsychAgent 同时带有 SFT/技能/RFT，无法归因到 '记忆设计'。

evidence.quote: Across 522 matched dialogues, PsychAgent is ranked first by both human raters and the LLM rater
evidence.support_explanation: 独立于训练奖励的人评：仅三个系统（PsychAgent、Qwen3-Max、TheraMind），25 个案例，两名心理学研究生。
人评得分：PsychAgent 比 Qwen3-Max 高约 0.35 分（1-5 量表）。

evidence.quote: all three raters concentrate heavily on high scores, with 4-5 accounting for 78.8%-81.7% of all dimension-level ratings
evidence.support_explanation: 人评存在天花板效应；human-human QWK 0.675。

evidence.quote: although they should be interpreted as benchmark trends rather than direct clinical evidence.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认结果不是临床证据；客户为模拟，评测是基准趋势。

evidence.quote: Importantly, these packages should not be interpreted as newly invented canonical techniques.
evidence.support_explanation: 内化后的 '功能技能' 被作者保守解释为已知微技能的组合。

evidence.quote: Dialogue / session count 6701 729 Counselor turns 154,966 20,869
evidence.support_explanation: SFT 数据 6701 会话 vs 内化数据 729 会话：内化阶段的数据只有 SFT 的约 11%。

evidence.quote: Future work will focus on evaluating the framework in more realistic counseling settings and strengthening safety and privacy protections for real-world deployment.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认尚未在真实咨询环境验证。

evidence.quote: using LLMs-as-a-Judge
evidence.support_explanation: The RFT selection reward is a PsychEval-style LLM judge; §4.1 adopts the PsychEval evaluation protocol for the reported metrics, so training selects on the evaluator family it is scored by.

evidence.quote: Training is conducted on two servers, each equipped with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs.
evidence.support_explanation: Hardware and settings only: no GPU-hours, rollout counts, judge calls, tokens or dollars anywhere.

gap.author_gap: 心理咨询 AI 多为 SFT 后静态；人类咨询师通过经验循环积累技能；现有模型缺乏跨会话持久记忆与规划，并且很少把学到的行为反映到参数中。
gap.checked_gap: 部分成立：'静态' 的描述与 TheraMind 等已含跨会话规划和适应的邻居有冲突；本文没有测量 '静态模型随经验不再进步' 的程度；gap 中的 '技能抽取+内化' 是一个组合目标而非被检验的瓶颈。
gap.lineage: ChatCounselor/SoulChat（SFT）→ AutoCBT/PsyDT（多 agent/数字孪生）→ MusPsy/PsyDial/PsychEval（多会话）→ TheraMind（跨会话规划+适应）→ 本文：技能树演化 + RFT 内化。通用 '自演化 agent'（SAGE、Richelieu、ELL）仅在相关工作中点名。近邻原文不在固定材料中。
gap.closest_adjacent: TheraMind（跨会话规划与适应）；MusPsy；PsyDT；通用自演化 agent/技能库方法（如 SAGE、ELL）。
gap.residue: 未证明演化出的技能（相对初始库）带来增益；未把 '内化' 的效果与同等数据上的普通 SFT 区分。
gap.stakes: 多会话咨询的一致性与专业性；本文以基准分数代理。
gap.method_response: 三引擎闭环：记忆规划保证连续性，技能演化沉淀策略，RFT 把技能内化。
gap.remaining_gap: 演化库 vs 初始库对照；仅 SFT 基线；奖励独立性；真实/临床场景；成本；评测期冻结。
gap.unresolved: 近邻（TheraMind、MusPsy、通用技能库自演化）原文未固定，无法核对其已实现的程度。

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 在 PsychEval 基准的 LLM-judge 指标（约 100 个留出画像）与一个三系统小规模人评中，包含 SFT、记忆规划、技能树演化和 RFT 内化的 PsychAgent 系统得分高于所列通用与领域基线；去掉任一引擎都会降低分数。但没有 '仅 SFT' 与 '初始库 vs 演化库' 的对照，且优势远大于消融降幅，因此不能把差距归因于经验驱动的终身学习或技能演化；harness 级（技能树）留存收益未被单独证实。

G.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Static post-SFT counselors and fixed skill libraries are named; TheraMind already adapts across sessions and is separated in one sentence; 'static' is not measured.

M.reason: Opus sides with son55. The loop (shared selected trajectory → skill extraction and RFT; skills read via <skill>) is concrete, but the selection reward is the evaluator family (opus:O01), append/merge and extraction are themselves learned behaviours with no stated quality criterion, and no prediction separates evolved skills from the initial library or RFT from plain SFT.

X.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Engines, formulas, N=8 and training settings are given; no skill admission gate or rollback, tree size/versioning, append/merge ratio, judge identity, RFT iteration count or evaluation-time freeze.

E.measurement.reason: Opus sides with son55. The reported PsychEval metrics come from the same LLM-judge protocol that selects RFT trajectories (opus:O01), so the main metric is one the system is optimized against, with simulated clients. The human study (522 dialogues, QWK 0.675, ranking agreement) is a real independent anchor and keeps this at 2, but it covers three systems, shows ceiling effects, and does not state rater blinding.

E.causality.reason: Opus sides with son55. There is no same-backbone SFT-only arm and no initial-vs-evolved skill tree arm; w/o SEE removes the whole engine. Ablation drops (0.06–0.52) are far below the gaps to baselines (1.07–1.44), so most of the headline advantage is unattributed (SFT on the benchmark's own corpus, reward = evaluator). Table 4 swaps backbones. sol's 2 credited the ablation table as isolating components.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. 120/20 profile split per school; SFT-corpus/profile overlap and the evaluation-time freeze are unstated; all schools seen.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1 (A2 ladder): evaluation and human-study sizes, QWK and neutral memory results are reported; single runs with no intervals.

E.cost.reason: Shared correction (both seats 1). Searched the full text and Appendices A–C: there are no GPU-hours, rollout totals, judge-call counts, tokens, dollars or inference cost comparisons. Hardware (16 H200), N=8, epochs and the 729-session internalization set are settings, not cost evidence (r12a UI-Mem precedent).
